prompt.explain_block_header: Provide a clear breakdown of the following {l2Code} text. Include:
prompt.explain_block_item2: A phrase-by-phrase breakdown explaining how the text is constructed
prompt.explain_morphology: Give its pronunciation. If it is an inflected or conjugated form, state its dictionary form and explain the inflection. If it is not inflected, do not mention inflection or lemma.
prompt.explain_ticks: Wrap every {l2Name} word, phrase, or whole sentence in single backticks (`). Wrap entire example sentences as one backticked span, e.g. `その劇団は、古典を現代的に解釈するという新機軸を打ち出して、若い観客を魅了した`, not just the target word. Never nest backticks.
prompt.explain_word: Please succinctly explain the {l2Name} word "{word}", then give 2 examples with translations.
prompt.explain_word_context: Please succinctly explain the {l2Name} word "{word}" in "{context}", then give 2 examples with translations.
prompt.explain_word_context_form: Please succinctly explain the {l2Name} word "{word}" (inflected form: {contextForm}) in "{context}", then give 2 examples with translations.
prompt.explain_word_examples: Also give 2 examples of how the word is typically used.
prompt.explain_word_examples_context: Also give 2 examples of how the word is used in the same sense as in the context provided.
prompt.followup_etymology: Please give the etymology of the {l2Name} word "{word}".
prompt.followup_inflection: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the {l2Name} word "{word}", how the word is inflecting, and the meaning of the inflected form.
prompt.followup_inflection_context: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the {l2Name} word "{word}", how the word is inflecting in "{context}", and the meaning of the inflected form.
prompt.followup_inflection_context_form: Please explain the lemma (dictionary form) of the {l2Name} word "{word}" (inflected form: {contextForm}), how the word is inflecting in "{context}", and the meaning of the inflected form.
prompt.followup_morphemes: Please explain whether the {l2Name} word "{word}" can be broken down into semantic parts (morphemes), and note any literal interpretations of the word.
prompt.followup_morphemes_context: Please explain whether the {l2Name} word "{word}" in "{context}" can be broken down into semantic parts (morphemes), and note any literal interpretations of the word.
prompt.followup_syntax: Please explain whether the {l2Name} word "{word}" is functioning as a syntactic element, and explain what the syntactical structure is (e.g. sentence structure, part of a phrase, a certain grammatical phenomenon, etc).
prompt.followup_syntax_context: Please explain whether the {l2Name} word "{word}" in "{context}" is functioning as a syntactic element, and explain what the syntactical structure is (e.g. sentence structure, part of a phrase, a certain grammatical phenomenon, etc).
